item.title: Yuhang Economic Development Zone: "Qihang Road" Connects to a New Industrial Future
item.description: HANGZHOU, China, Feb. 25, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- The Hangzhou Municipal Government has recently approved the official names for five stations along Metro Line 10 and the Hangzhou-Deqing Intercity Railway (Yuhang Section). Within the core area of Yuhang Economic Development Zone, two stations have been renamed: Renhe South Station is now "Dongshanyang Station," while Renhe North Station has been designated "Qihang Road Station" (literally "Setting Sail Road"). item.title: WATCH: Commotion at EDSA
item.description: Commotion erupts as police block the entry of protesters making way to EDSA shrine, which was tagged as a “no-rally” zone.The Catholic Church, through Caritas Philippines President Bishop Gerry Alminaza, tried to mediate by talking to the authorities but a clash ensued.VIDEO BY ALLEN LIMOS AND JAMES DANIO
